name: Zwei Club Mate bitte

It’s one of those lovely summer evenings in Cologne. The sun starts to set around 11 p.m. The temperature has cooled to a comfortable level. The local kiosk is stocked with refreshing drinks. Two trans girls meet up to talk while watching the sunset.
